E000.desc: 攻撃能力はほとんどないが、無限とも思われる耐久力を持つ。
E000.name: 影人間

E001.desc: 洞窟や廃村に群れで住む小型の亜人。知能は低く力も弱いが狡猾で、罠や待ち伏せを好む。
E001.name: ゴブリン

E002.desc: 草原に群れで暮らす温厚な魔獣。普段は草を食むだけだが、危険を感じると体毛に魔力を帯びさせ、静電気のような衝撃を放つ。
E002.name: メリー

E003.desc: 巨大化した凶暴な蜂。森や花畑に巣を作り、縄張り意識が非常に強い。群れで襲うと冒険者でも危険。
E003.name: キラービー

E004.desc: 暗い洞窟や廃墟に生息する大型のコウモリ。音波で周囲を探り、獲物を混乱させる。性格は臆病だが空腹時は凶暴化。
E004.name: オオコウモリ

E005.desc: 湿地帯に住む魔力を帯びた巨大カエル。舌を伸ばして獲物を捕らえるほか、毒の粘液を飛ばす個体もいる。
E005.name: フロッグ

E006.desc: 都市の下水や廃墟に群生する巨大化したネズミ。繁殖力が高く、群れで行動する。性格は凶暴で、病原菌を持つことも多い。
E006.name: 大ネズミ

E007.desc: 湿地や洞窟に発生する半液体生物。一見無害に見えるが、獲物を溶かす粘液で包み込む。物理攻撃が効きにくい。
E007.name: スライム

E008.desc: 地中に巣を張る巨大蜘蛛。獲物を待ち伏せる習性があり、糸で動きを封じてから毒牙で仕留める。
E008.name: ツチグモ

E009.desc: 森や山に住む粗暴な獣人。力が強く、集落を作って生活する。性格は好戦的で、弱者を見れば襲いかかる。
E009.name: オーク

E010.desc: 魔力で動く骸骨の兵士。墓地や遺跡に出現し、命令に忠実に従う。感情はなく、痛みも感じない。
E010.name: スケルトン

E011.desc: 湿った森や洞窟に群生する魔性のキノコ。胞子で仲間同士がゆるく繋がっており、危険を察知すると毒胞子を撒き散らす。
E011.name: マッシュ

E012.desc: 森や山岳地帯に群れで暮らす獣。高い知能と連携力を持ち、リーダーの指示で獲物を追い詰める。
E012.name: ウルフ

E013.desc: 湿地や湖畔に生息する巨大亀。分厚い甲羅でほとんどの攻撃を防ぎ、ゆっくりとした動きながらも縄張りに入る者には容赦しない。
E013.name: トータス

E014.desc: 墓地や古代遺跡に漂う霊体。感情が薄く、ただ彷徨い続ける存在だが、強い魔力に引き寄せられる習性がある。
E014.name: スピリット

E015.desc: 戦場に残った怨念が骨に宿り、戦士として蘇った存在。生前の戦闘技術をわずかに保持しており、錆びた剣や盾を巧みに扱う。
E015.name: スカルファイター

E016.desc: 熱帯の川や湖に群れで生息する肉食魚。水中では驚異的な速度で動き、血の匂いに敏感。群れで獲物に噛みつき、瞬く間に肉を削り取る。
E016.name: ピラニア

E017.desc: 魔力や呪いで蘇った死骸の犬。腐敗した体ながら俊敏で、狂暴性が増している。群れで襲われると非常に危険。
E017.name: ゾンビドッグ

E018.desc: 荒野や街道に潜む人間の無法者。金品を狙って旅人を襲うが、戦闘力は個体差が大きい。危なくなるとすぐ逃げる臆病さも持つ。
E018.name: 盗賊

E019.desc: 草原や湿地に生息する大型の蛇。静かに獲物を待ち伏せ、素早い噛みつきで毒を注入する。温度変化に敏感で、夜間は動きが鈍る。
E019.name: スネーク

E020.desc: 海を荒らす無法者の海賊。船上での戦闘に長け、斧や銃火器を扱う。粗暴で欲深いが、仲間意識は強い。
E020.name: パイレーツ

E021.desc: 鉱山や洞窟に住む小柄な獣人。器用で道具作りが得意なため、罠や簡易武器を多用する。群れで行動すると急に強気になる
E021.name: コボルド

E022.desc: 湿地帯や密林に咲く巨大な魔性の花。甘い香りで獲物を誘い寄せ、近づいた者に毒の花粉を浴びせる。周囲の生態系を支配する厄介な存在。
E022.name: ラフレシア

E023.desc: 戦争で命を落とした兵士の怨念が鎧に宿った存在。生前の戦闘技術をわずかに保持しており、盾と剣を使った堅実な戦い方をする。
E023.name: ソルジャー

E024.desc: 魔力に取り憑かれた魔族や魔法生物。知能が高く、遠距離から魔法弾や状態異常の呪文を放つ。
E024.name: マジシャン

E025.desc: 墓地や戦場跡に現れる動く死体。腐敗しているため動きは鈍いが異常に打たれ強い。群れで現れると脅威が増す。
E025.name: ゾンビ

E026.desc: 海岸や浅瀬に生息する巨大カニ。硬い甲殻で物理攻撃を弾き、鋭いハサミで挟みつける。縄張り意識が強く、近づく者には容赦しない。
E026.name: クラブ

E027.desc: 山岳や荒野に住む巨体の獣人。怪力と耐久力に特に優れる。知能は低いが、怒りに任せた突進は凄まじい破壊力。
E027.name: オーガ

E028.desc: 呪いで蘇った巨大カエル。腐敗した体から毒の粘液を垂れ流し病原菌を撒き散らすため、接近戦は非常に危険。
E028.name: イビルフロッグ

E029.desc: 海底に潜む巨大ヒトデ型魔物。中心部を破壊しない限り再生し続ける生命力を持つ。触手のような腕で吸い付き、体力を吸収する。
E029.name: イビルスター

E030.desc: 草原に群れで暮らす大型魔獣。温厚だが縄張りに入る者には突進で応戦する。その体当たりは凄まじく、地面を揺らすほどの威力。
E030.name: バッファロー

E031.desc: 闇に紛れて生きる人型の暗殺者モンスター。森や廃寺などに潜み、気配を完全に消す能力を持つ。性格は冷酷で任務に忠実。
E031.name: ニンジャ

E032.desc: 湿地帯や川辺に住む爬虫類型の亜人。集落を作り、独自の戦士文化を持つ。冷血で感情が読みにくいが、縄張りを侵す者には容赦しない。
E032.name: リザードマン

E033.desc: 山岳地帯に生息する巨大な猛禽。鋭い視力で遠くの獲物を見つけ、急降下して鋭い爪で仕留める。性格は誇り高く、縄張り意識が強い。
E033.name: イーグル

E034.desc: 魔力の高い地域に発生する知能型スライム。脳のような器官を持ち、精神干渉能力が強い。狡猾で、獲物の思考を乱して混乱させる。
E034.name: ブレイン

E035.desc: 墓地や呪われた地に現れる死の化身。実体が薄く、鎌の一撃は魂そのものを削る。感情はなく、ただ死を運ぶ存在。
E035.name: 死神

E036.desc: 深海や魔力の強い湖に棲む巨大魚。鱗がドラゴンのように硬く、口から高圧の水流や小さな火花を吐く個体もいる。
E036.name: ドラゴンフィッシュ

E037.desc: 海底洞窟に潜む巨大タコ。高い知能を持ち、岩陰に隠れて獲物を待ち伏せる。吸盤で絡め取り、強力な締め付けで動きを封じる。
E037.name: オクトパス

E038.desc: 湿地帯や川辺に生息する巨大ワニ。水中では驚異的な速度で動き、陸上でも短距離なら素早い。獰猛な性格。
E038.name: クロコダイル

E039.desc: 古い森の守護者として生まれた木製の巨人。魔力で動き、感情はほとんどないが森を守る本能が強い。
E039.name: ウッドゴーレム

E040.desc: 海上に現れる歌声の魔物。美しい歌で船乗りを惑わせ、海へ誘い込む。性格は気まぐれで、興味を持った者だけを狙う。
E040.name: セイレーン

E041.desc: 古代遺跡や城の屋根に潜む石像魔獣。昼は完全に石化して動かず、夜になると魔力で活動を始める。
E041.name: ガーゴイル

E042.desc: 深い森に生息する巨大熊。普段は温厚だが、縄張りに入る者には激しい怒りを見せる。冬眠前は特に凶暴化する。
E042.name: グリズリー

E043.desc: 砂漠の地中を泳ぐように移動する巨大虫型魔物。振動に敏感で、地表を歩く者を獲物と認識して襲いかかる。
E043.name: ワーム

E044.desc: 聖なる森に住む神秘の獣。純粋な心を持つ者にしか姿を見せず、傷ついた者を癒す力を持つ。性格は高潔で誇り高い。
E044.name: ユニコーン

E045.desc: 古い森の守護者として生まれた樹木の巨人。ゆっくりとした動きだが、怒らせると大地を揺らすほどの力を持つ。
E045.name: トレント

E046.desc: スライムの一種で、より柔軟性と跳躍力に優れたゼリー状生物。色によって性質が異なり、酸性・電気・冷気などの属性を持つ個体もいる。
E046.name: ジェリー

E047.desc: 山岳地帯に巣を作る獅子と鷲の合成獣。誇り高く、縄張りに入る者には容赦しない。風を操る個体も存在する。
E047.name: グリフォン

E048.desc: 満月の夜に変身する呪われた虎人間。普段は理性を保つが、変身時は獰猛で凶暴。俊敏な動きと鋭い爪による連撃が特徴。
E048.name: ワータイガー

E049.desc: 呪われた蛇髪の魔族。洞窟や廃神殿に住み、侵入者を石化の視線で狩る。性格は孤独で執念深い。
E049.name: メドゥーサ

E050.desc: 魔術によって動く巨大な岩の守護者。感情はなく、命令された範囲を黙々と守り続ける。物理攻撃に非常に強い。
E050.name: ストーンゴーレム

E051.desc: 騎乗した魔装兵。荒野や古戦場に現れ、疾風のような速度で突撃してくる。性格は冷徹で、命令に忠実。
E051.name: ホースナイト

E052.desc: 草原に君臨する獅子型魔獣。群れの頂点に立つ個体は特に強靭で、咆哮で周囲の敵を威圧する。性格は誇り高く、弱者を狙うことは少ない。
E052.name: レオ

E053.desc: 迷宮や地下遺跡に棲む牛頭の巨人。怪力と耐久力に優れ、狭い通路でも突進してくる。性格は粗暴で、侵入者を見つけると怒り狂う。
E053.name: ミノタウロス

E054.desc: 沼地や湖に潜む多頭の竜。頭を切り落としても再生する生命力を持つ。性格は獰猛で、縄張りに入る者を容赦なく襲う。
E054.name: ヒュドラ

E055.desc: 深海に潜む巨大な海魔。船を沈めるほどの巨大触手を持ち、海流を操る力もある。性格は冷酷で、海上の振動に敏感。
E055.name: クラーケン

E056.desc: 夜の城や廃屋に潜む吸血の魔族。高い知能と魅了の力を持ち、影のように動く。性格は冷静で狡猾。多彩な攻撃手段を持つ。
E056.name: ヴァンパイア

E057.desc: 山岳や火山に棲む伝説級の魔獣。強靭な鱗と巨大な翼を持ち、爪、尾、ブレスの三拍子が揃った最強格。性格は誇り高く、侵入者には容赦しない。
E057.name: ドラゴン

E058.desc: 古代の魔法器具に封じられた精霊。ランプをこすると現れ、強大な魔力を振るう。性格は気まぐれで、人間を試すような行動を取ることも。
E058.name: 魔人

E059.desc: 通常のドラゴンを遥かに凌ぐ古代種。大陸を揺るがすほどの力を持ち、空を飛ぶだけで嵐が起こる。性格は神に近いほど尊大。
E059.name: グレートドラゴン

E060.desc: 深海の神格に近い魔物。巨大な魚人の姿を持ち、海底都市を支配する存在。性格は冷酷で、人間を獲物としか見ない。
E060.name: ダゴン

E100.desc: A bakemono raider. Spears and jade make it squeal.
E100.name: Goblin

E101.desc: The one with the straw hat. Very fetching. (Crab Ch1 tutorial)
E101.name: Goblin in a Hat

E102.desc: A ratling who distrusts Squeak. Quick and nervous.
E102.name: Nezumi Warrior

E103.desc: Carapace shrugs off knives. Crush it.
E103.name: Cave Beetle

E107.desc: It wants your eyes. It'll settle for your rice ball.
E107.name: Carrion Crow

E108.desc: A hitodama: a soul-flame that leads travellers off the cliff path. Blades pass half through it.
E108.name: Will-o'-wisp

E109.desc: Head down, tusks first. Taller than it looks when it's coming at you.
E109.name: Wild Boar

E106.desc: The tribe's shaman. Name-magic makes you forget your own name.
E106.name: Nezumi Shaman

E120.desc: A mountain of a ronin. Doesn't talk to Crab dogs. Wrestles them.
E120.name: Gonta

E190.desc: A sturdy test goblin for battle-system checks.
E190.name: Straw-Hat Brute (training)

E230.desc: A bakemono veteran in an iron hat. Frenzied.
E230.name: Goblin Warmonger

E231.desc: Escaped from the Kuni cells. Stitched, angry, and very fast.
E231.name: Goblin Experiment

E233.desc: A restless ghost. Blades pass half through her.
E233.name: Yurei

E237.desc: The same drunk, twenty years and a promotion later.
E237.name: Drunken Samurai

E236.desc: Mutsuye's humble yojimbo. He fights to first blood, and he means it.
E236.name: Shiba Noboru

E235.desc: A kitchen servant with someone else's voice in his mouth.
E235.name: Maho Puppet

E234.desc: Chained in the donjon for the Kuni. Its chains were filed.
E234.name: Troll

E238.desc: A Crane Iron Warrior with a warrant for a deserter and no sense of humour.
E238.name: Daidoji Agent

E239.desc: A Lion who races the way he fights: early, loud and with his elbows.
E239.name: Matsu Braggart

E240.desc: Shadowlands-born, Taint in its teeth. Frenzied, and there are always more.
E240.name: Goblin Warmonger

E241.desc: A dead man the Shadowlands kept walking. Slow; it doesn't let go.
E241.name: Zombie

E242.desc: A demon horse: bone, shadow and a red eye. Very fast.
E242.name: Onikage

E243.desc: A slab of Shadowlands muscle with a club.
E243.name: Ogre

E244.desc: A red flower with teeth. It turns to follow you.
E244.name: Toothed Poppy

E245.desc: A dead Unicorn rider on skeletal wings. It hunts by sight.
E245.name: Moto Akutsukai

E246.desc: A maho-warrior in stolen Crab armour.
E246.name: Maho-bujin

E247.desc: A patrol leader with a second face on the back of its head. Every third turn it swaps two travelers' commands.
E247.name: Oni no Kommei

E248.desc: The face on the back of the Kommei's head. Break it and the swaps stop.
E248.name: The Other Face

E250.desc: A goblin on a Shadowlands wolf. Kill the wolf and the goblin falls; kill the goblin and the wolf goes mad.
E250.name: Bakemono Wolf-rider

E251.desc: Up the ladders with a knife in its teeth.
E251.name: Goblin Warmonger

E252.desc: Blood-sorcery in Crab armour, inside the castle walls.
E252.name: Maho-bujin

E253.desc: It broke through to the cellar stair and it wants the courtiers. Draw it off them.
E253.name: Cellar Ogre

E254.desc: A slab of Shadowlands muscle on the wrong side of the Wall.
E254.name: Ogre

E255.desc: A bone-cage full of tentacles that bounces like a monstrous ball. Its bounces chain from traveler to traveler.
E255.name: Oni no Tsukakoro

E256.desc: A troll that climbed the Wall in the night and went for the nearest watchtower. Bent swords bother it.
E256.name: Wall Troll

E300.desc: A Kakita senior with a bokken and a big mouth. The graduation bout (b_bokken_bout).
E300.name: Senior Student

E302.desc: Lean and grey, and never alone.
E302.name: Grey Wolf

E301.desc: One of the Green Ronin's people: a farmer with a stick and a straw hat. Surrenders when hurt (b_forest_bandits_a/b).
E301.name: Forest Bandit

E313.desc: Silent, inhumanly calm. He hesitated once, to cut a peasant. Never again.
E313.name: Kakita Yasurugi

E314.desc: A Daidoji sentry with glazed eyes. The lady said the Crab come at dawn.
E314.name: Seduced Sentry

E315.desc: An Iron Crane general, held by Miyako's charm. She heals him while he fights. Break him to free him.
E315.name: Daidoji General

E326.desc: The woman in white, on the ridge. She never fights. She never risks herself.
E326.name: Doji Miyako

E327.desc: A barefoot ronin who walks on mooring ropes. Her charm makes her hard to hit; break her to shatter it.
E327.name: Chihaya the Quick

E328.desc: The second brother, laughing at the prow in a storm. He fights like the deck is his.
E328.name: Yosuke the Bold

E330.desc: An albino maho-tsukai who paints charms in his own blood. Every turn he hands one out.
E330.name: Katsuo the White Brother

E331.desc: The eldest brother: a Mantis tactician, tired, with a nunchaku. He offered you a way out.
E331.name: Ryohei the Eldest

E334.desc: A long grey eel that rises out of the swell and wraps the rail.
E334.name: Sea Serpent Eel

E337.desc: A bald head the size of a hill, rising out of a storm. Blades pass half through it.
E337.name: Umibozu Shade

E342.desc: A sheet of forbidden text that got up and walked. Its edges are very sharp.
E342.name: Paper-spirit

E343.desc: An ink pot four hundred years old, still full. It throws.
E343.name: Ink-pot Spirit

E344.desc: A paper lantern with a grin and a tongue. The censor-monks swear they never light it.
E344.name: Lantern Spirit

E346.desc: A Doji ancestor, set to guard shelf nine. It does not approve of you.
E346.name: Shelf Kami

E348.desc: A Shiba ashigaru guarding Phoenix rice warehouses. Rice meant for the Crane army.
E348.name: Phoenix Guard

E349.desc: The visiting Matsu sensei, with many voices in his mouth. Break the possession to save him.
E349.name: Possessed Matsu Nagai

E358.desc: A Bloodspeaker, the beloved of Iuchiban, in a borrowed body. Break him to bind a jade chain; three chains hold him.
E358.name: O-Tamai

E360.desc: A Bloodspeaker, the beloved of Iuchiban, in a borrowed body. Break him to bind a jade chain; three chains hold him.
E360.name: O-Tamai

E359.desc: A shadow that crawls up behind its master. It eats the breath, not the blood.
E359.name: Red-shadow Oni

E361.desc: The bokken tournament: first blood, no seconds.
E361.name: Ikoma Bard

E362.desc: The bokken tournament: first blood, no seconds.
E362.name: Matsu Duellist

E363.desc: The bokken tournament: first blood, no seconds.
E363.name: Kaiu Yutaka

E364.desc: Ianwa's leavings: a crawling shape of dread. Blades pass half through it.
E364.name: Fear Shade

E365.desc: A cowardly oni the size of a horse. It has no attacks of its own: it charms. At its first Suki it flees.
E365.name: Oni no Ianwa

E372.desc: He collects a toll from people who have nothing. A duel: first blood.
E372.name: Bandit Chief

E373.desc: "Bandits" in good boots. Paid in Imperial coin. They surrender at low HP.
E373.name: Pass Ronin
E373.rt_mercy: Enough! We yield! We were only paid to take a tube!

E374.desc: The old man of Kaze-no-Tani. Pain, he says, is a rumour.
E374.name: Akodo Shogen

E375.desc: A tall man with a long, perfect blade. His order: the message never arrives.
E375.name: Seppun-trained Duelist

E376.desc: An archer on the rocks above, in no colours at all.
E376.name: Miya Archer

E381.desc: A Matsu who charged the ford by mistake. Knock him down; don't kill your own.
E381.name: Matsu Berserker
E381.rt_mercy: ...Akodo-sama? Why are we in the river? Why was I so afraid?

E382.desc: A Matsu who charged the ford by mistake. Matsu Joruri's victory stone told you where he'd break.
E382.name: Matsu Berserker
E382.rt_mercy: ...Akodo-sama? Why are we in the river? Why was I so afraid?

E383.desc: The Crane counter-charge. They fall back when beaten. Don't pursue.
E383.name: Crane Rider
E383.rt_mercy: Fall back! Back to the bank! They're not following!

E384.desc: Archers on the far bank, shooting into the mist.
E384.name: Crane Archer

E385.desc: The old bridge, burning. Push the burning timbers into the river: a spear does it best.
E385.name: Burning Bridge

E388.desc: The Matsu champion, ridden by a Fear-demon. Its eyes are black and wide. Obsidian strips its guard, at a price.
E388.name: Matsu Rokuro

E389.desc: Your cousin. He started this war in one night. A duel: first blood, nobody dies.
E389.name: Akodo Gusai

E390.desc: A Matsu who wants a duel before dawn. First blood.
E390.name: Matsu Berserker

E394.desc: A shard of the broken shrine's stone guardian, lurching upright. It doesn't know the shrine is gone.
E394.name: Guardian-stone

E395.desc: A samurai's ghost in a silent hurricane. Blades pass half through him. Every other turn his wind seals spells.
E395.name: Ashimoshi

E399.desc: A Bloodspeaker, the beloved of Iuchiban, in a borrowed body. Break him to bind a jade chain; three chains hold him.
E399.name: O-Tamai

E400.desc: One of Kokujin's peasants, with the Togashi tattoos painted on wrong. Fights in a frenzy.
E400.name: Painted Cultist

E401.desc: A thin man in red at the back of the mob, gesturing, sweating. He'll run the moment it turns.
E401.name: Hioninmaru

E402.desc: Kokujin's bloodspeaker, back for the Consumer scroll. His maho costs him blood; his blood Taints. Without his cultists he loses his nerve.
E402.name: Hioninmaru

E405.desc: Bruised smoke from the Darkfever, drifting between the trees. Its touch burns.
E405.name: Fever Spirit

E406.desc: A hungry ghost, drawn to the dying villages.
E406.name: Gaki

E407.desc: An earth spider with a demon's face on its back. It webs the old shrines.
E407.name: Tsuchigumo

E408.desc: Isawa Mieko's other half, black-glass eyes. She came back to where she was broken. She'll run at half her strength.
E408.name: Mieko (dark half)

E409.desc: Like a body falling down stairs forever. Every second turn its breath knocks a traveler Off-Balance and it steadies itself (+2 Resolve). The Darkfever burns everyone near it.
E409.name: Oni no Kuzushi

E410.desc: Like a body falling down stairs forever. Every second turn its breath knocks a traveler Off-Balance and it steadies itself (+2 Resolve). The Darkfever burns everyone near it.
E410.name: Oni no Kuzushi

E430.desc: A river imp with a dish of water on its head. Bow to it: it must bow back, and the water spills out. (the Bow: instant Suki)
E430.name: Kappa

E434.desc: One of Akuro's guards, dull eyed: "...the end of your rope..." Interrogate cuts the sentence.
E434.name: Hypnotised Guard

E435.desc: An Imperial guard of the year 400. Perfect iaijutsu. He wants to die; don't let him. (Below 25%: break him or Subdue him)
E435.name: Seppun Ushimo

E436.desc: A palace guard with a straight tachi, deserted when the gaijin landed. Resists Katana.
E436.name: Palace Guard

E437.desc: A foreign soldier behind a very long pike. Resists Yari.
E437.name: Gaijin Pikeman

E438.desc: A foreign soldier with a smoking tube that throws lead. (Using a dropped musket: History -15)
E438.name: Gaijin Musketeer

E440.desc: The gaijin vanguard's captain, with a broadsword. When he falls, his men give up.
E440.name: Vanguard Captain
E440.rt_captain: The powder room explodes. When the smoke clears, Akuro is gone.

E441.desc: An old ise zumi who wears faces. The Crab tattoo takes his wounds; the Wasp gives him a second blow. He can't be beaten: fell the vanguard captain.
E441.name: Togashi Akuro

E445.desc: A Gusai marine with a boarding axe, paid in gaijin silver. Resists Water.
E445.name: Gusai Mantis Marine

E446.desc: The gaijin pike wall, pushing up the hill. Hold for six turns and the relief arrives.
E446.name: Gaijin Vanguard

E447.desc: Gusai Iami's hired blade. A duel: no seconds.
E447.name: Iami's Champion

E448.desc: The failed artist, painting at the rail with the last vial of kami-ichor at his hip. Break him before the 8th round, or the vial goes overboard.
E448.name: Kakita Kumpei

E421.desc: He swings a gaff at anyone who stares. Gendo was deducing.
E421.name: Drunk Sailor

E422.desc: One of Tadayasu's Storm Legion thugs, kama in each hand. Told to put the fish back in the water.
E422.name: Kama Thug

E425.desc: One of Tadayasu's Storm Legion thugs, kama in each hand.
E425.name: Kama Thug

E423.desc: A ronin shugenja with dull eyes, murmuring the same sentence. While the callers stand, the tide comes in. Interrogate cuts the sentence.
E423.name: Hypnotised Shugenja

E424.desc: A Mantis thug with the same dull eyes and the same sentence.
E424.name: Mantis Thug

E449.desc: "Hand over the purse, pretty!" He has a purse of his own, very loosely tied.
E449.name: Road Bandit

E455.desc: The thing that wore the Kitsune governor, face slipping, standing on the river. Its breath makes you forget who you are.
E455.name: Kommei-brood Oni

E456.desc: A leech as long as a dog, from the marsh that used to be a wood. Salt makes it let go.
E456.name: Blood Leech

E457.desc: Bloated on the dead from the barge.
E457.name: Blood Leech

E460.desc: Kitsune Hana, possessed by a Greater Kansen, lifting the iron box over the blood pit. Steel only annoys it; crystal and magic hurt it. Break her and she drops the box.
E460.name: Kansen-Hana

E462.desc: A python thick as a man's thigh, from the flooded paddies.
E462.name: Paddy Python

E463.desc: A hornet the size of a cat. There's never only one.
E463.name: Giant Hornet

E466.desc: A monk of the Silent Self with a cloth face sewn over his own. Break him and the stitches tear: the soul inside goes free.
E466.name: Stitched-face Monk

E467.desc: A stitched-face monk on the temple paths. "Give us your face."
E467.name: Stitched-face Monk

E470.desc: An Emerald Magistrate's badge on her obi. She favours her right leg and doesn't let you see it. She is no longer a magistrate of the Empire.
E470.name: Doji Siko

E471.desc: The abbot of the Monastery of the Silent Self, kneeling before the faceless shadow. Only crystal hurts him fully. Halfway down he puts on his true mask, and copies your courage.
E471.name: Abbot Munashii

E477.desc: One of the Iuchi officers who 'disappeared' in the war: a basket hat, a mask, meishodo amulets. They rose out of the earth.
E477.name: Iuchi Shugenja

E478.desc: The squad's anchor, hung with amulets. While he stands, the air goes still every other turn: no spell makes a sound.
E478.name: Amulet-bearer

E412.desc: A fragment of the dark half. It knows every spell Haruki knows.
E412.name: Mieko's Shadow

E413.desc: A fragment of the dark half, nearer the torii. It knows every spell Haruki knows.
E413.name: Mieko's Shadow

E414.desc: Mieko's dark half on the red torii cliff, the book in her hands. Her Void drains yours. The dream keys loosened her; the gentle echoes stand between you.
E414.name: Mieko (dark half)

E415.desc: Mieko's dark half on the red torii cliff, the book in her hands. Her Void drains yours. The dream keys loosened her; the gentle echoes stand between you.
E415.name: Mieko (dark half)

E416.desc: Mieko's dark half on the red torii cliff, the book in her hands. Her Void drains yours. The dream keys loosened her; the gentle echoes stand between you.
E416.name: Mieko (dark half)

E417.desc: Mieko's dark half on the red torii cliff, the book in her hands. Her Void drains yours. The dream keys loosened her; the gentle echoes stand between you.
E417.name: Mieko (dark half)

E350.desc: A duel: first blood. No seconds.
E350.name: Akodo Ozaki

E351.desc: A duel: first blood. No seconds.
E351.name: Akodo Gusai

E352.desc: A duel: first blood. No seconds.
E352.name: Shiba Ashimita

E357.desc: A Shiba guard at Kamatori who wants to know what a Lion is made of. A duel: first blood.
E357.name: Shiba Guard

E347.desc: Rensei's father. The duel he has feared all his life: first blood, at dawn.
E347.name: Kakita Masanori

E259.desc: A restless ghost. Blades pass half through her.
E259.name: Yurei

E303.desc: Lean and grey, and never alone.
E303.name: Grey Wolf

E305.desc: Head down, tusks first. Taller than it looks when it's coming at you.
E305.name: Wild Boar

E307.desc: A hitodama: a soul-flame that leads travellers off the cliff path. Blades pass half through it.
E307.name: Will-o'-wisp

E309.desc: Head down, tusks first. Taller than it looks when it's coming at you.
E309.name: Wild Boar

E311.desc: A hitodama: a soul-flame that leads travellers off the cliff path. Blades pass half through it.
E311.name: Will-o'-wisp

E312.desc: Lean and grey, and never alone.
E312.name: Grey Wolf

E320.desc: A restless ghost. Blades pass half through her.
E320.name: Yurei

E325.desc: A restless ghost. Blades pass half through her.
E325.name: Yurei

E379.desc: Lean and grey, and never alone.
E379.name: Winter Wolf

E387.desc: The demon's terror wave: shapes of dread rising out of the mist.
E387.name: Fear Shade

E366.desc: Lean and grey, and never alone.
E366.name: Mountain Wolf

E369.desc: A restless ghost. Blades pass half through her.
E369.name: Yurei

E371.desc: Ianwa's leavings: a crawling shape of dread. Blades pass half through it.
E371.name: Fear Shade

E354.desc: Lean and grey, and never alone.
E354.name: Grey Wolf

E356.desc: A hitodama: a soul-flame that leads travellers off the cliff path. Blades pass half through it.
E356.name: Will-o'-wisp

E396.desc: Lean and grey, and never alone.
E396.name: Grey Wolf

E398.desc: A hitodama: a soul-flame that leads travellers off the cliff path. Blades pass half through it.
E398.name: Will-o'-wisp

E403.desc: Lean and grey, and never alone.
E403.name: Mountain Wolf

E404.desc: A restless ghost. Blades pass half through her.
E404.name: Yurei

E443.desc: A foreign soldier behind a very long pike. Resists Yari.
E443.name: Gaijin Pikeman

E444.desc: A foreign soldier with a smoking tube that throws lead. (Using a dropped musket: History -15)
E444.name: Gaijin Musketeer

E452.desc: It wants your eyes. It'll settle for your rice ball.
E452.name: Carrion Crow

E454.desc: A hitodama: a soul-flame that leads travellers off the cliff path. Blades pass half through it.
E454.name: Will-o'-wisp

E458.desc: A bakemono raider. Spears and jade make it squeal.
E458.name: Goblin

E465.desc: A restless ghost. Blades pass half through her.
E465.name: Yurei

E468.desc: A hitodama: a soul-flame that leads travellers off the cliff path. Blades pass half through it.
E468.name: Kansen Wisp

E469.desc: A sheet of forbidden text that got up and walked. Its edges are very sharp.
E469.name: Paper-spirit

E474.desc: Lean and grey, and never alone.
E474.name: Mountain Wolf

E475.desc: A hungry ghost, drawn to the dying villages.
E475.name: Gaki

E428.desc: It wants your eyes. It'll settle for your rice ball.
E428.name: Carrion Crow

E418.desc: A restless ghost. Blades pass half through her.
E418.name: Frost Spirit

E420.desc: A hitodama: a soul-flame that leads travellers off the cliff path. Blades pass half through it.
E420.name: Kansen Wisp

E340.desc: A long grey eel that rises out of the swell and wraps the rail.
E340.name: Sea Serpent Eel

E341.desc: A bald head the size of a hill, rising out of a storm. Blades pass half through it.
E341.name: Umibozu Shade

E329.desc: One of the brothers' crew, in a white sash, with a paper charm tucked in it.
E329.name: White Squid Pirate

E332.desc: One of the brothers' crew, in a white sash, with a paper charm tucked in it.
E332.name: White Squid Pirate

E489.desc: A refugee with a club and nothing to lose, after the rice.
E489.name: Camp Thug

E490.desc: A farmer with powder-black hands and a kama. He'd rather go home.
E490.name: Peasant Guerrilla

E491.desc: Tamotsu's fellow student. Silk under dirty cotton, a gaijin dao, and a hatred of both castles. Water spoils his powder.
E491.name: Naohida

E492.desc: A keg of gaijin pepper. Any Fire sets it off: a blast that hits everyone, on both sides.
E492.name: Powder Keg

E493.desc: "Hand over the purse, pretty!" He has a purse of his own, very loosely tied.
E493.name: Road Bandit

E494.desc: Lean and grey, and never alone.
E494.name: Grey Wolf

E497.desc: Carapace shrugs off knives. Crush it.
E497.name: Cave Beetle

E498.desc: Startled doves from the cliff, a hundred of them, all beak.
E498.name: Pigeon Swarm

E499.desc: A cave guard with a pitchfork. He'd rather go home.
E499.name: Peasant Guerrilla

E479.desc: Lean and grey, and never alone.
E479.name: Winter Wolf

E481.desc: White fur, a black muzzle, and very little patience. It hugs.
E481.name: Snow Bear

E482.desc: A crow's head, a swordsman's hands. It fights the way a crow laughs.
E482.name: Tengu Crow-Warrior

E483.desc: A pale wolf that casts no shadow. Blades pass half through it.
E483.name: Wolf-Spirit

E484.desc: A walking flame with a coal for a heart. The Tamori say it's the Furnace thinking.
E484.name: Fire Elemental

E485.desc: A pilgrim the Furnace took, still walking, made of ash and old prayers.
E485.name: Ash Ghoul

E487.desc: Three flames in a lava tube, standing guard for no one.
E487.name: Fire Elemental

E488.desc: Ash-shrine dead, risen out of the offerings.
E488.name: Ash Ghoul

E486.desc: A maho-tsukai who has hunted the Iron Box since Kudo, wearing Mitsue's face. At two-thirds and one-third of its blood it steals another face, and that face's weaknesses.
E486.name: Bloodspeaker Remnant

E502.desc: Lean and grey, and never alone.
E502.name: Mountain Wolf

E503.desc: A hungry ghost, drawn to the dying villages.
E503.name: Gaki

E505.desc: One of the Iuchi officers who 'disappeared' in the war: a basket hat, a mask, meishodo amulets. They rose out of the earth.
E505.name: Iuchi Shugenja

E506.desc: The squad's anchor, hung with amulets. While he stands, the air goes still every other turn: no spell makes a sound.
E506.name: Amulet-bearer

E507.desc: A castle servant, possessed through the ears. Still in an apron. Break it and it wakes.
E507.name: Singing Servant

E508.desc: The ones on the stair, at a child's barricaded door. Break them and they wake.
E508.name: Singing Servant

E509.desc: A miner, or a miner's wife, or a miner's child. The mine didn't let them rest.
E509.name: Risen Dead

E510.desc: A hungry ghost, drawn to the dying villages.
E510.name: Gaki

E512.desc: The quiet dead of the jade mines, standing in rows. They feel no fear.
E512.name: Risen Dead

E513.desc: A corpse in Iuchi armour three hundred years old, risen from the mine's cracked shrine. Woken by the Regret above.
E513.name: Mine Guardian

E514.desc: One of the Emperor's own Emerald Legion, wax-less, marching in a circle in the wind, chanting a dead woman's name.
E514.name: Possessed Legionnaire

E515.desc: A dead Unicorn rider on skeletal wings. It hunts by sight.
E515.name: Moto Akutsukai

E516.desc: A castle servant, possessed through the ears. Still in an apron. Break it and it wakes.
E516.name: Singing Servant

E517.desc: A Legion squad marching in a circle at the tunnel's narrowest point, chanting.
E517.name: Possessed Legionnaire

E518.desc: One of the three Shuten Doji, Fu Leng's sensei of maho: a shape made of every apology no one ever made. Its servants' song possesses whoever hears it. Jade hurts it.
E518.name: Shuten Doji of Regret

E519.desc: Eighty, a monk's robe, the kanji for Void burned into his skull. He summoned Regret for want of a son. Possessed, he still prays like a master.
E519.name: Iuchi Kurosho

E520.desc: A dock thug who shoves fish-sellers into the river for fun.
E520.name: Dock Thug

E521.desc: A ronin of Daigoro's band, a scarred lip, dirty leather armour, a good wakizashi. He'll run at half.
E521.name: Tetsuo
E521.rt_fleebark: Not for Daigoro's money. Not for this.

E522.desc: A 'merchant' with a Lion's posture and a concealed katana. First blood satisfies him.
E522.name: Disguised Lion
E522.rt_fleebark: (dropping the merchant's hat) First blood. My honour is satisfied. Good day.

E523.desc: A crow-headed tengu in a red silk kimono, fencing on a log to make travellers look foolish. Vain about its feathers.
E523.name: Crow-Tengu
E523.rt_fleebark: Caw! A worthy crossing! (it flaps off, sulking)

E525.desc: A bakemono with a basket of stolen pilgrim offerings. Each one looks slightly different from his neighbour.
E525.name: Goblin

E526.desc: An old woman with cloudy eyes, inside her mud hut. The walls take most of the blows. Fire will flush her out.
E526.name: Tomie Cho

E527.desc: The last of a family cursed for drinking from a sacred well: a weretiger, too old to catch rabbits. The eta don't run very fast.
E527.name: Tomie Cho

E529.desc: It wants your eyes. It'll settle for your rice ball.
E529.name: Carrion Crow

E530.desc: Head down, tusks first. Taller than it looks when it's coming at you.
E530.name: Wild Boar

E532.desc: A bakemono raider. Spears and jade make it squeal.
E532.name: Goblin

E533.desc: One of Lord Ikoma Sadanobu's retainers. He beat a pilgrim into the snow because he was told to. He'll run at half.
E533.name: Ikoma Retainer
E533.rt_fleebark: (dropping the spear in the snow) The lord can hold his own criminals!

E534.desc: Sadanobu's men, down the jetties with torches in a storm. Not paid enough for this. They'll give up when it goes badly.
E534.name: Ikoma Retainer
E534.rt_mercy: Enough! Enough! Lord Sadanobu doesn't pay us for storms!

E535.desc: Sadanobu's captain. Old enough to know better, loyal enough not to say so.
E535.name: Retainer Captain
E535.rt_mercy: (lowering the katana) ...Enough. I yield. The boy isn't worth my men.

E536.desc: An enforcer of the Order of the Snake, a tattoo on the wrist, the face covered. The Order removes usurpers. Spies too.
E536.name: Snake Enforcer

E537.desc: A snake of shadow, peeled off the den wall. Blades pass half through it. Fire and wind blow it out.
E537.name: Shadow-Snake

E538.desc: A snake of shadow that slides along the den walls. Blades pass half through it. Fire and wind blow it out.
E538.name: Shadow-Snake

E543.desc: One of the Order's watchers: a farmer by day, a black-edged tanto by night. He knows two other members. He'd die before naming them.
E543.name: Order Watcher

E544.desc: The enforcer who speaks for the den. Grey robes, a black-edged blade, eyes that catch the candlelight. He has removed usurpers before.
E544.name: Enforcer of the Order

E551.desc: A rebel Imperial guard of three hundred years ago, frost in his lacing, replaying the night. Blades other than the katana pass half through him.
E551.name: Ghost-Guard

E552.desc: A rebel guard of the White Snow. The basin behind him keeps calling him back to his post.
E552.name: Ghost-Guard

E553.desc: The lord whose guards stole the prince, cut in two in the pagoda three hundred years ago. He still wants the throne. He still screams.
E553.name: Shade of the Crab Lord

E554.desc: A stone basin on a pedestal, heaped with red stones. Pure blood touched impure stone here. It is empty, and very still, and it calls the dead back to their posts.
E554.name: Bloodstone Basin

E545.desc: A Lion ashigaru at the north road checkpoint. Wave-folk go round by the goat track.
E545.name: Lion Border Guard

E546.desc: White fur, a black muzzle, and very little patience. It hugs.
E546.name: Snow Bear

E547.desc: A bear the size of a hut, white with old snow, that has eaten climbers before.
E547.name: Snow Beast

E548.desc: A restless ghost. Blades pass half through her.
E548.name: Frost Spirit

E549.desc: Lean and grey, and never alone.
E549.name: Winter Wolf

E550.desc: A pale wolf that casts no shadow. Blades pass half through it.
E550.name: Wolf-Spirit

E555.desc: A pilgrim in plain robes and very good sandals, a needle in each sleeve. Paid to make a choice look like a curse. He runs when it hurts.
E555.name: Scorpion Agent
E555.rt_fleebark: (dropping the needle) Not for what they're paying!

E556.desc: Black cloth, soft feet, and orders to make sure the eta girl never reaches the crater. The rooftops are his road.
E556.name: Scorpion Assassin

E557.desc: Waiting on the switchback, where the stair is narrow and the drop is long. The last of the two dozen.
E557.name: Scorpion Assassin

E559.desc: A great serpent-bodied warrior in a pearl-white robe, the Great Naga's champion, the Order's guardian. Not evil. Poison runs off him like seawater. Sent to make sure the choice is the right one.
E559.name: The Naga's Champion

E558.desc: A walking flame with a coal for a heart. The Tamori say it's the Furnace thinking.
E558.name: Fire Elemental

E562.desc: Out of the Shinomen with the host, ahead of it, looting as it goes.
E562.name: Goblin Raider

E563.desc: A slab of Shadowlands muscle on the wrong side of the Wall.
E563.name: Ogre

E564.desc: A demon horse: bone, shadow and a red eye. Very fast.
E564.name: Onikage

E565.desc: A dead Unicorn rider on skeletal wings. It hunts by sight.
E565.name: Moto Akutsukai

E566.desc: A small oni with no name yet, newly crawled out of a summoner's mistake. It wants one.
E566.name: Oni Spawn

E567.desc: The host's vanguard. The first wave is always goblins. It's tradition.
E567.name: Goblin Raider

E568.desc: Soaked in lamp oil and set alight by its friends, still laughing. Water puts it out. So does dying.
E568.name: Goblin Fanatic

E569.desc: A slab of Shadowlands muscle under the ram.
E569.name: Ogre

E570.desc: The ogre at the front of the ram, iron-collared, shouting in a language of grunts.
E570.name: Ogre Captain

E572.desc: A demon horse loose inside the stockade, going for the abbot's hall.
E572.name: Onikage

E573.desc: Last year's dead from the burned villages, walked back across the plain.
E573.name: Zombie

E574.desc: A dead Unicorn rider at the breach, and the dead come after it.
E574.name: Moto Akutsukai

E571.desc: Polished Seppun armour over something that isn't a man. It took the name Natsuko left in a tunnel, and it loves it.
E571.name: "Ryozo"

E575.desc: Out of the Shinomen behind the host: a spider the size of a hut, eyes like wet coals, and a smell of the Festering Pit.
E575.name: Many-Legged Horror

E576.desc: Pale violet spiders the size of dogs, out of the silk under the Shinomen's roots. They come in clutches.
E576.name: Kumo Brood

E580.desc: A Shadowlands poppy, growing where nothing of hers should grow. It turns to follow you, and it has teeth.
E580.name: Toothed Poppy

E581.desc: One of the old hermit's children, from the branches over his fire. It was listening. It did not like your tone.
E581.name: Kumo

E582.desc: A pale wolf that runs a hand's breadth above the moss and does not bend the ferns.
E582.name: Wolf-Spirit

E579.desc: A young oni guarding the path for her, fat on silk and fear. It has no name yet, and it would very much like yours.
E579.name: Oni Spawn

E577.desc: A pearl-and-bronze serpent warrior of the waking Naga, scouting a forest that has changed while it slept. Not evil. Not hers. Break its guard and it will listen.
E577.name: Naga Scout
E577.rt_mercy: (the pearl spear lowers; a hiss like surf) Not ours to stop. Pass, warm-bloods.

E578.desc: The spirit of a Lava Tree, carried out of the Shadowlands and planted in the Shinomen: charred bark, fire in the cracks, roots for hair.
E578.name: Lava Tree Dryad

E583.desc: The Bride, rising into the air on wings of smoke. Her seduced champions take her wounds for her. Sometimes she isn't there at all: crystal or jade finds her.
E583.name: Doji Nashiko

E584.desc: A samurai who met her at a court, once. His eyes are on her and nowhere else. Her wounds open on him. (Blood Shouting)
E584.name: Seduced Champion

E585.desc: The glade is gone: an inky starfield, and her in it. Every moment here, you grow older.
E585.name: Body of Damned Time

E586.desc: Her loveliness peeled away: a black-edged wound in her throat pulsing with Fu Leng's glowing blood, empty sockets glowing blue. Jade, crystal and obsidian hurt her. She is colour-blind, she fears disfigurement, and she wanted one word all her life.
E586.name: The Empress of Nothing
E586.rt_fleebark: (cornered, her face flickering through every disguise) I was going to be EMPRESS-

E540.desc: A python thick as a man's thigh, from the flooded paddies.
E540.name: Paddy Python

E541.desc: A river imp with a dish of water on its head. Bow to it: it must bow back, and the water spills out. (the Bow: instant Suki)
E541.name: Kappa

E587.desc: Born under the Wall, in a nest a woman with blue eyes paid for. It has never seen the sky.
E587.name: Nest Goblin

E588.desc: A demon horse stabled in the dark under the Kaiu Wall, waiting for a rider.
E588.name: Nest Onikage

E589.desc: Something small and new that the nest was feeding. It was going to be big.
E589.name: Nest Oni Spawn

E590.desc: A Unicorn rider in white death-paint, years dead, on a horse that isn't one. He rode in to die well, and something rode out wearing him. Benjiro's father.
E590.name: Moto Akutsukai

E591.desc: A goblin from the deep Shadowlands, where nothing has ever seen the sun and everything is hungry.
E591.name: Fallen Goblin

E592.desc: Bigger than the ones that come to the Wall. The deep makes them bigger.
E592.name: Fallen Ogre

E593.desc: A demon horse gone feral in the deep, with no rider to want.
E593.name: Fallen Onikage

E594.desc: A Moto rider dead so long the white paint has worn to bone.
E594.name: Fallen Akutsukai

E595.desc: A kami of the deep places, corrupted past remembering its name.
E595.name: Fallen Kansen

E596.desc: A young oni that crawled out of the Festering Pit and kept going.
E596.name: Fallen Oni Spawn

E597.desc: A maho-tsukai who walked into the deep to be closer to his master, and found him.
E597.name: Fallen Bloodspeaker

E598.desc: An old troll of the deep, grey as a cliff. It has eaten Crab armour for three hundred years and it still regrows what you cut off.
E598.name: Troll Elder

E599.desc: A young orochi, green scales gone grey, lost up the black rivers into the Shadowlands and mad with it.
E599.name: Orochi-spawn

E600.desc: A Hiruma bushi who died holding the castle, fifteen generations ago, and is holding it still. Against you.
E600.name: Restless Hiruma

E601.desc: A castle ogre, fat on the old stores. It sleeps in the stables.
E601.name: Fallen Ogre

E602.desc: A dead rider who stables in the Hiruma's own stalls now.
E602.name: Fallen Akutsukai

E603.desc: A maho-tsukai who keeps Okura's court, and her rage.
E603.name: Fallen Bloodspeaker

E604.desc: One of Okura's brood, playing in the ruins.
E604.name: Fallen Oni Spawn

E605.desc: An old troll of the deep, grey as a cliff, living in the Hiruma's well.
E605.name: Troll Elder

E606.desc: Akuma took the Jade Champion's name, and with its power made a daughter to carry on his rage. She has Shiro Hiruma now, and the Hiruma ancestors in its walls.
E606.name: Oni no Okura

E607.desc: A sea serpent out of Sakkaku, green as deep water, with eyes gold in the lightning. It keeps the ships it sinks, and the souls aboard them. It has no sense of humour at all.
E607.name: The Orochi
